location_name: Spratly features claimed by Malaysia (Pulau Layang-Layang, Terumbu Laksamana, Pulau Amboyna Kecil)
summary: Deputy Foreign Minister Reezal Merican Naina Merican told the Dewan Negara on 8 December 2015 that Malaysia's South China Sea claim rested on the 1979 map covering nine or eleven maritime features, including Pulau Layang-Layang, Terumbu Laksamana and Pulau Amboyna Kecil, that disputes must be settled under international law including UNCLOS with referral to the ICJ or an arbitral tribunal an available option, and that Malaysia conducted patrols, surveillance and enforcement and raised the issue at the November ASEAN summit.
actors: Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Reezal Merican Naina Merican; Dewan Negara
reasoning: A parliamentary statement of the extent of Malaysia's claim and its legal basis is a verbal assertion; declarative. It names Amboyna Cay (occupied by Vietnam) and Commodore Reef (held by the Philippines), so the dyads include Vietnam and the Philippines.

sources.title: Hansard, Dewan Negara, 2015-12-08: Oral answer No. 8 on the South China Sea (Reezal Merican)
sources.excerpt: saya hendak maklumkan bahawa tuntutan yang dilakukan oleh Malaysia hanyalah berdasarkan kepada Peta 79

location_name: Luconia Shoals (Beting Patinggi Ali), off Miri, Sarawak
summary: Shahidan Kassim told the Dewan Negara on 14 December 2015 that diplomatic protest notes had been sent over the China Coast Guard intrusions at Beting Patinggi Ali, that the MMEA's Sarawak region sent monthly monitoring reports on the Chinese ships to strengthen Malaysia's control of the area, that the government had agreed to add MMEA patrol assets, and that a wooden structure bearing foreign writing found at the shoal had been removed because the area was Malaysia's.
actors: Minister in the Prime Minister's Department Shahidan Kassim; MMEA Sarawak Maritime Region; Dewan Negara
reasoning: A ministerial account of protests and of removing a foreign marker is a verbal assertion; declarative. The removal of the foreign structure is itself a physical act (possibly coercive) but no date is given, so it is reported inside this statement rather than as its own event.

sources.title: Hansard, Dewan Negara, 2015-12-14: Winding-up, Prime Minister's Department (Shahidan Kassim) on Beting Patinggi Ali
sources.excerpt: struktur daripada kayu yang menunjukkan ada tulisan asing di papan yang berkenaan. Itu kita buang sebab ini kawasan kita.
